title: Add explicit A2A task kind metadata
summary: A2A idempotency caching still derives task kind from intent text. Add an optional explicit task_kind field so retries and duplicate-result replay can group logical work by stable type without coupling cache keys to human-readable instructions.
expectedFailureModes: Idempotent duplicate replay misses equivalent tasks because intent text changed while the logical task kind stayed the same.
Blank task kind metadata is accepted and creates ambiguous cache keys.
Legacy tasks without task_kind fail to deserialize or lose the existing intent_text fallback.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant-a2a task_kind --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenant-a2a idempotency --locked
cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd a2a_auto_retry --locked
nextAction: Add optional task_kind to A2ATask, validate non-empty values, prefer it in idempotency cache keys with legacy intent_text fallback, update tests and idempotency docs/status.
